title: SRA Development Planning — Input Schema
note: Fields required to run the 33(10) calculator. `regulation_ref` cites the DCPR clause governing that input. All areas can be entered in sqm; sqft equivalents are auto-computed. Fields with `source: proposal` pre-fill from the parent proposal row.

groups.title: Basic Project Information
groups.help: Identifiers and location. Most fields pre-fill from the accepted proposal.

fields.label: CTS Number
fields.help: e.g. 1(PT)

fields.label: Village
fields.help: Revenue village

fields.label: Ward
fields.help: e.g. N, K/W, L, M, S, T

fields.label: Location
fields.help: e.g. Ghatkopar (W)

fields.label: Development Zone
fields.help: Determines rehab-to-sale base ratio. Island City = 0.75, Suburbs = 1.00, Difficult Area = 1.30 (industry rounding of DCPR 1.333). Difficult-Area ratio REPLACES the large-scheme incentive (does not stack).

groups.title: Plot Area & Site Constraints
groups.help: Gross plot and every deduction that reduces the FSI-computable area.

fields.label: Gross Plot Area
fields.help: Total plot before any deductions

groups.title: Road Access
groups.help: The widest abutting road governs FSI table lookups and 33(10) rehab-to-sale ratio.

fields.label: Primary Road Width
fields.help: Widest abutting road, e.g. 27.45

groups.title: Land Deductions (per Reg 30(A)(2) & 14(A))
groups.help: Each deduction reduces the net plot area available for FSI computation. Every field cites its governing DCPR clause.

fields.label: Primary DP Road Setback Deduction
fields.help: Land under primary DP road / road-widening

fields.label: Nalla / Storm Water Setback
fields.help: Setback from major nalla / water body

fields.label: Recreational Open Space (ROS 2.7 / Green Belt)
fields.help: ROS required under Reg 27 is a physical set-aside but is NOT deducted for FSI/BUA computation (Reg 30(A) Note 1).

fields.label: Other DP Reservation Area (School / Garden / Chowky etc.)
fields.help: DP reservations OTHER than ROS. These DO reduce the FSI-computable area.

fields.label: Amenity Plot (per Reg 14(A))
fields.help: Auto-computed if left blank: applies statutory % of gross plot area per Reg 14(A). Enter override only if a different area is being surrendered.

fields.label: Plot Area for FSI Computation (with add-backs)
fields.help: Optional. Net plot + areas added back (DP road, ROS, buildable reservations). Leave blank to use Net Plot Area. Malad-E-style projects: enter the 'plot for FSI' from your feasibility (typically gross − nalla − amenity).

fields.label: Buildable Reservation (School / Higher Ed / Market) — Total Area
fields.help: Raw area of buildable reservation being handed over (e.g. RE 1.1 Municipal School). Informational — actual deducted portion goes in 'Other DP Reservation' field above.

fields.label: Sale Incentive from Buildable Reservation Handover
fields.help: Additional sale BUA earned by handing over a buildable reservation (e.g. Municipal School). Added on top of the rehab-component × sale-ratio. Malad-E ref: 4,230 sqm school → 1,912.15 sqm sale incentive.

groups.title: Rehabilitation Component Inputs (33(10) SRA)
groups.help: Everything about the eligible slum dwellers and rehab tenement design.

fields.label: Eligible Tenements
fields.help: Confirmed eligible hutment-dwellers after Slum Act Chapter I-B verification

fields.label: Welfare / Balwadi / PAP Tenements
fields.help: Adds to total rehab tenement count for maintenance deposit calc

fields.label: Carpet Area per Rehab Tenement
fields.help: Statutory minimum per DCPR 33(10) VI 1.1 = 25 sqm carpet (includes balcony, fungible, bath, WC — excl. common areas).

fields.label: Rehab BUA Loading Factor
fields.help: Multiplier applied to carpet to get BUA per tenement (walls + staircase + lift wells + common passages). Typical Mumbai high-rise SRA: 1.25–1.30. Ghatkopar reference verified at 1.283.

fields.label: Amenity Common Area (Balwadi, WC, Society Office, Common Passage)
Religious Structures BUA
fields.help: Per GR 05/05/2011 & 18/11/2015 — counted in rehab component

groups.title: Additional Planning Inputs
groups.help: Fungible strategy, TDR intent, in-situ constraints.

fields.label: Fungible % to Apply
fields.help: Statutory max 35% (res). Fungible on rehab component is free of premium; fungible on sale is chargeable.

fields.label: In-Situ FSI Cap
fields.help: Statutory in-situ maximum is 4.0. Balance goes to TDR.

fields.label: Sale BUA Proposed in Situ
fields.help: Optional — how much sale BUA the developer intends to build on the plot. Balance is available as TDR.

fields.label: Actual Tenement Density (per net ha)
fields.help: If existing density > 650/ha, CEO SRA may allow in-situ FSI > 4
